title: Russell Targ coming around to remote viewing as precognition

tellings.quote: I think Russell targ even has sort of come around to that idea

plain: A physicist named Russell Targ, known for studying remote viewing (the practice of trying to describe faraway places or hidden targets with the mind alone), is said to have come around to the idea that it really works by seeing the future. A writer on precognition named Eric Wargo says this to Michels as his own impression, without naming a source. If so, a leading figure in the field would be treating remote viewing as a glimpse ahead in time rather than across space.
